sources.title: Nscale Raises $3.36 Billion in Pre-IPO Convertible Financing

event.title: Nscale $3.36 billion pre-IPO convertible financing
event.summary: Nscale announced convertible loan notes led by Third Point. The initial tranche closed, with an additional NVIDIA commitment expected to fund later.

amounts.label: Convertible loan notes
amounts.quote: London, U.K., 25 September, 2026—Nscale Limited, the full-stack AI cloud platform, today announced its $3.36bn raise via convertible loan notes, led by Third Point.

amounts.label: Initial tranche at closing (included)
amounts.quote: The financing consists of an initial $2.36bn tranche at closing and an additional $1bn commitment from NVIDIA with funding expected in mid-November, 2026.

amounts.label: NVIDIA commitment (included)
amounts.quote: The financing consists of an initial $2.36bn tranche at closing and an additional $1bn commitment from NVIDIA with funding expected in mid-November, 2026.

facts.label: IPO conversion
facts.text: The loan notes convert automatically into shares when Nscale completes its initial public offering.
facts.quote: The loan notes are convertible into ordinary shares (or non-voting shares in the case of NVIDIA) automatically upon completion of Nscale's initial public offering.
